recognition

(noun). sự công nhận

Ex: There is a general recognition of the urgent need for reform.

engagement

(noun). sự tham gia

Ex: Her views are based on years of engagement with the problems of the inner city.

lever

(noun). đòn bẩy

Ex: This could serve as a powerful lever for peace.

appreciation

(noun). sự trân trọng

Ex: She shows little appreciation of good music.

boost

(verb). thúc đẩy

Ex: The movie helped boost her screen career.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

generate

(verb). tạo ra, phát ra

Ex: We need someone to generate new ideas.

invisible

(adjective). Vô hình

Ex: She felt invisible in the crowd.

reward

(noun). phần thưởng

Ex: You deserve a reward for being so helpful.

serve

(verb). dùng cho, đảm nhiệm

Ex: The sofa will serve as a bed for a night or two.

performance

(noun). hiệu suất công việc, sự thể hiện

Ex: Her academic performance has been inconsistent.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

meaningless

(adjective). vô nghĩa

Ex: We fill up our lives with meaningless tasks.

monotonous

(adjective). đơn điệu

Ex: The housewives were asked if they found housework monotonous.

perform

(verb). Biểu diễn, trình diễn, thực hiện

Ex: A computer can perform many tasks at once.

simulation

(noun). sự mô phỏng

Ex: Simulation models are used to predict earthquake patterns.

task

(noun). công việc

Ex: The first task for the new leader is to focus on the economy.

various

(adjective). khác nhau, đa dạng

Ex: We talked about jobs, family, football and various other things.

company

(noun). công ty

Ex: It is the world's largest software company.

fulfillment

(noun). sự hoàn thành

Ex: Being here is the fulfillment of a lifelong ambition.

comprehend

(verb). hiểu

Ex: She could not comprehend how someone would risk people's lives in that way.

ability

(noun). khả năng, năng lực

Ex: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.

allocation

(noun). sự phân bổ

Ex: The allocation must be made according to a strict set of criteria.

express

(verb). bày tỏ, thể hiện

Ex: Teachers have expressed concern about the changes.

fairness

(noun). sự công bằng

Ex: She has a strong sense of justice and fairness.

justice

(noun). công lý

Ex: She spent her life fighting for social justice and equality for women.

manifest

(verb). biểu lộ

Ex: The symptoms of the disease manifested themselves ten days later.

quest

(noun). Hành trình tìm kiếm

Ex: The team will continue its quest for Olympic gold this afternoon.

resource

(noun). Nguồn tài nguyên

Ex: They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.

voice

(verb). Bày tỏ, nói lên

Ex: A number of parents have voiced concern about their children's safety.

merge

(verb). hợp nhất

Ex: His department will merge with mine.

defend

(verb). bảo vệ, phòng thủ

Ex: The role of the military is to defend the country.

belong

(verb). Thuộc về, của

Ex: The islands belong to Spain.

motivate

(verb). Khuyến khích, tạo động lực

Ex: What motivates people to carry out such attacks?

lack

(verb). thiếu

Ex: The team lacked the skill to compete at the highest level.

worry

(verb). lo lắng

Ex: He's always worrying about his weight.

global

(adjective). Mang tính toàn cầu

Ex: This year the global economy will grow by about 4 per cent.

local

(adjective). Thuộc về địa phương

Ex: It was difficult to understand the local dialect.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

bond

(verb). liên kết, gắn bó

Ex: The hospital gives mothers some private time in which to bond with their babies.

commitment

(noun). sự cam kết

Ex: Players must make a commitment to play for a full season.

cooperate

(verb). hợp tác

Ex: The two groups agreed to cooperate with each other.

former

(adjective). trước đó

Ex: This beautiful old building has been restored to its former glory.

present

(verb). thể hiện

Ex: The company has decided it must present a more modern image.

unusual

(adjective). lạ, khác thường

Ex: It's unusual for the trees to flower so early.

attitude

(noun). Thái độ

Ex: If you want to pass your exams you'd better change your attitude!

analyze

(verb). phân tích, đánh giá

Ex: He tried to analyze his feelings.

relation

(noun). mối quan hệ

Ex: Little of what he said has any relation to fact.

acquire

(verb). nhận được, đạt được

Ex: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.

advancement

(noun). sự tiến bộ

Ex: technological/economic/medical advancement

profit

(noun). lợi ích, lợi nhuận

Ex: The agency is voluntary and not run for profit.

reward

(verb). khen thưởng

Ex: She was rewarded for her efforts with a cash bonus.

tie

(verb). buộc, liên kết, nối

Ex: Their company's future is closely tied to our own.
